notes.title: Global Release Timing for Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
notes.notes:
Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds will be available September 25, 2025! Get prepared by knowing the release time in your region.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/39598389b98842d91027e55e2cbdf1ec5303f0fd.png"]
[hr][/hr]
Don’t want to wait until September 25th? Pre-order the Digital Deluxe Edition to play three days early. You’ll also receive the Season Pass – 6 Content Packs that include guest characters, vehicles, tracks, emotes, and more from some of your favorite pop culture franchises, and the Sonic Prime Character Pack!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2486820/_/"][/dynamiclink]
Free Demo available now 
Download the free single-player demo and try out 4 characters, 8 courses (3 main courses + 5 CrossWorlds), 12 different Machines, and customize playstyle with 20 Gadgets. Test out Grand Prix and Time Trial modes, and explore the Garage to personalize your vehicle.
